key_insight: The paper shows that many production “INT8” diffusion transformer paths on consumer Ampere GPUs never actually use INT8 tensor cores, and a fused Triton INT8 GEMM fixes that bottleneck.
engineering_relevance: Replacing dequantize-to-bf16 linear layers with a true int8xint8->int32 kernel makes INT8 the fastest option on single consumer GPUs for Ideogram 4.0 inference at practical resolutions.
method: Built a fused Triton INT8 GEMM for Ampere tensor cores
Folded per-token x per-channel dequantization and bias into the epilogue
Autotuned the kernel per GEMM shape and swapped it into the model’s linear layers
evidence_signal: The kernel matched the reference numerically and ran 2.8-4.2x faster per GEMM, producing a ~9-10% end-to-end speedup at 768px and 156.5 s/image at 1024px on an RTX 3090, faster than NF4 and FP8 baselines.
watch_item: The performance win is hardware-specific to consumer Ampere; on A100 and B200, native bf16/FP8 paths outperform this INT8 approach.
paper_title: Realizing Native INT8 Compute for Diffusion Transformers on Consumer GPUs: A Fused INT8 GEMM Kernel for Ideogram 4.0
